notes: Undated scanned booklet (page last updated 2018-09-21) with no text layer; Rajshahi Division entries (booklet pp. 21-23) transcribed by hand from the page images (raw/*.png). fetch.py verifies the PDF hash and re-emits the transcription. bdpost.gov.bd publishes no office list (its postcode menu points to ekdak.com); the 88-page 'all post offices' list and the telephone directory on the same portal are also image-only scans and were not transcribed. Branch post offices are not in the booklet. No licence stated. Licence: none stated on the source; treat as government public information, cite the source.
